text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The racers come charging furiously<n>down the track!
Can the pack leader<n>evade their dogged pursuit?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Oh no, I can already hear the others<n>approaching.
Their acceleration is<n>completely different to anything
I've<n>experienced before!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to win... I need to win... I have<n>to win... That's
all that matters right<n>now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I won't surrender the crown to<n>anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew... Hey, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: R-Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: See you at the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You know, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On our way back to the waiting room,<n>Ines Fujin
turns to me, still tentatively<n>cradling her overheated
limbs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Having everyone's focus on me like<n>that... it felt
completely different from<n>any other race I've
experienced so<n>far.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. They were on a completely<n>different level.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It might be a heck of a lot tougher to<n>win the Derby
than I imagined.
choice_data_list: But that's your dream, isn't it?
But that's your dream, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well... After running this race,<n>I'm feeling
more motivated than ever!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It really hit me! I want to be faster<n>than anyone else
and lead the pack!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna get even better! I've<n>got to get faster
and faster...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Because I want to win.
choice_data_list: I'll lead you to victory as the favorite!
I'll lead you to victory as the favorite!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm gonna hold you to that,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Seriously though, that might feel<n>pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I'll go out there with everyone's<n>eyes on me like
today... I'll face them<n>head-on... and I'll snatch
victory out<n>from under their noses!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on TV
text_block_list.text:
"Since I was born an Umamusume, I<n>always felt it
was my calling to<n>become a Derby champion."

text_block_list.name: Interview Transcript
text_block_list.text:
"For us Umamusume, there's one<n>title that we all
dream of acquiring."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I am an Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so tomorrow is a day off, but<n>we'll get stuck
into training the day<n>after that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Have a good night, Trainer. Sweet<n>dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, winning as the favorite?<n>You've got pretty
high hopes for me,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh—whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... That was a close call! It'd be<n>super
embarrassing if I got injured<n>by being careless.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: "If it matters to you, it matters to me,<n>too."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: "If it matters to you, it matters to me,<n>too."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When we first started, you supported<n>me in
continuing my part-time work<n>despite my training
obligations.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now, I want to fulfill my side of the<n>bargain and
make your dream come<n>true too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So let's make this Derby ours,<n>Trainer.
